dialogues.speaker: Muisa
dialogues.text: Hey, do you... believe in fate?

dialogues.speaker: Mitl
dialogues.text: Wh—What do you mean by that?

dialogues.speaker: Muisa
dialogues.text: I'm saying, you're here at the Masters of the Night-Wind to have your fortune told as well, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mitl
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean that! Yeah, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Mitl
dialogues.text: I'm planning to start farming on a new field near my place. There's two plots of land there that, to my eye, look the same, so I'm not sure...

dialogues.speaker: Muisa
dialogues.text: Ah, planting, I see... I mean, you should be able to get something good going either way.

dialogues.speaker: Mitl
dialogues.text: But speaking of that, what sorta fortune are you trying to have told?

dialogues.speaker: Muisa
dialogues.text: Flying practice. I've been training for a good long time — just wanna know when's the best take-off time for an easy pass!

dialogues.speaker: Mitl
dialogues.text: Uh, don't you think that depends more on wind direction and your skill?
